transcription: Dim mehldi'y wila wilhl win ksi hogwin bakwhl mismaaxwsxum gyet g̲o'ohl ts'ebi'm Gitwinhlguu'l gik'uuhl .
translation: I will tell about when the white men first came to Kitwancool long ago.

transcription: Ha'ondii 'nakw hlidaa bakwhl gyet dipun , ii sag̲aytg̲oodindiithl hli gyedihl Gitwinhlguu'l .
translation: Not long after these people arrived, they gathered together the people of Kitwancool.

transcription: Hasak̲diit dim mehldiit win hlaa dim sii ha'niijok̲t g̲o'ohl win t'aahl g̲alts'ephl Gitwinhlguu'l .
translation: They wanted to tell about the new place where the village of Kitwancool is to be.

transcription: 'Nit sag̲ootxwhl government siwetdiit , ii dim 'nii wenhl dim jok̲hl aluugigyet g̲o'ohl lax̲ reserve siwetdiit .
translation: The plan of the so-called government was that they will have Indian people live on a so-called reserve.

transcription: "Gu g̲anwilt," diyehl hli gyedihl Gitwinhlguu'l , "ehl 'nii jog̲o'm g̲o'ohl lax̲yibi'm g̲o'osun."
translation: "Why?" the people of Kitwancool asked. "We live on our land, here."

transcription: Ii nax̲'nidiit win dim bakwhl siwetdiit ehl surveyors .
translation: They heard that what they call surveyors were coming.

transcription: Way dimdii depdiithl g̲a'nagwihl 'naayeja'a dim win daa'whl reserve siwetxwist .
translation: They will measure out the length of the perimeter of what is called the reserve.

transcription: Ii aam win ky'ax̲ hehl Gitwinhlguu'l dim 'wiit'is , dim wag̲ayt jog̲o daa'whl g̲o'ohl k'i'yhl sg̲a'nist , dim ii lok̲'on daa'whl g̲o'ohl k'i'yhl aks , g̲o'ohl Ksen , 'nii g̲a'wayit k̲'ali daa'whl g̲o'ohl Meji'aadin . 'Nithl hasak̲diithl reserve .
translation: The people agreed that they wanted a big reserve which would encompass mountains starting from the Skeena all the way up to Meji'aadin. They wanted that for a reserve.

transcription: Way ii needii hehl Indian Agendima'a , siwetxwit ehl Indian Agent , ent sag̲aytg̲oodinhl gyet , sag̲aytwendiit .
translation: The Indian Agent disagreed, the so-called Indian Agent who gathered the people together for the meeting.

transcription: Ii 'nii win hehl hli gyedihl Gitwinhlguu'l , "Jidaa neejaa wilsi'm , way ii needimdii hasag̲a'm ehl k̲'am hlguts'uusxhl lax̲yiphl dim ksi jebisi'm."
translation: And the people of the village Kitwancool said, "If you don't do that, then we don't want you to carve out a very small reserve."

transcription: Way ts'ax̲ wildiihl hehl Gitwinhlguu'l ii needii hasak̲diit ehl reserve . "Needii hasag̲a'm dim dip suwii gi'namhl lax̲yibi'm," dihiida .
translation: And now even though the people of Kitwancool said they did not want the little reserve; "We don't want to give away our land," they said.

transcription: Ii hediitg̲at ehl Indian Agent dimt ha'widinhl surveyors , dim suwii huudindiithl surveyors .
translation: And they told the Indian Agent to stop the surveyors; they will chase away the surveyors.

transcription: Way , ts'ax̲ wildiihl hehl Gitwinhlguu'l ii needii hasak̲diithl reserve , ii hets'imox bakwtg̲athl surveyors .
translation: Even though Kitwancool said they did not want the reserve, the surveyors (apparently) came back.

transcription: Ii sit'aa'mam depdiithl hlidaaxhl hlgu lax̲ ha'niijok̲ .
translation: They started measuring out the little settlement.

transcription: Ii al'alg̲altg̲athl gyet hlis hediit ehl surveyors , "Neemdii hogyax̲ dim wilsi'm jidaa sit'aa'masi'm."
translation: So they stood by and watched after they told the surveyors, "It will not be right that you start."

transcription: Ii k̲'ap g̲aniwila yukwhl surveyors .
translation: But the surveyors continued.

transcription: Way ii sag̲aytg̲oodinhl ky'ulhl sim'oogit hli gyedihl Gitwinhlguu'l , ii hediit , "Dim sg̲asgitxu'm , dim suwii huudini'm 'nidiit."
translation: One chief gathered together some people of the village, and they said "We will oppose (them) and we will chase them away."

transcription: "Ii hasag̲a'm dim hogwin litxwhl k̲'ay limx̲sim gyet dim ent hlimoo'm."
translation: "We will want the support of young men to help us."

transcription: Way 'nithl wildiit .
translation: And that's what they did.

transcription: Iit hapdiithl surveyors .
translation: They mobbed the surveyors.

transcription: Iit dok̲diithl andeba'a , tape dip siwedit .
translation: They took the measuring tape (what we call tape in English).

transcription: Dok̲diithl anooya'a , surveyors equipment siwedihl anooya'ahl surveyors .
translation: They took the tools, surveyors' equipment, what the surveyors' tools were called.

transcription: Iit sim kwhlii hisyetsdiit ehl luuhligyootxw .
translation: And they completely chopped it up with axes.

transcription: Iit huudindiithl surveyors .
translation: And they chased away the surveyors.

transcription: Needii 'nakwt ii bakwhl police .
translation: Not long after, the police came.

transcription: Gidiidok̲diithl naahl g̲ay ha'niig̲ootdiit huksxwit ehl win sim kwhlii g̲atg̲oodindiithl anooya'ahl surveyors .
translation: They arrested people who they thought were around there when they destroyed the surveyors' tools.

transcription: Iit luuwendindiit .
translation: And they jailed them.

transcription: Hlist disekshl policehl gyet ent sim kwhlii hisyetshl anooya'ahl surveyors , ii g̲ani 'nihl hehl hli gyedihl Gitwinhlguu'l .
translation: After the police took away the men who destroyed the surveyors' tools, the Kitwancool people still objected.

transcription: "K̲'ap dim sg̲asgitxu'm."
translation: "We will absolutely oppose it."

transcription: Ii luuwenhl ligi gwilunima'ahl simgigyet g̲o'ohl Oakalla Prison siwetxwsit .
translation: And there were maybe three chiefs who were jailed at what was known as Oakalla Prison.

transcription: Ligi t'imisima'ahl k'uuhl luuwendiit .
translation: It wasn't recorded how many years they were incarcerated.

transcription: Way ii yukwhl luuwenhl simgigyet dipun , ii hets'imox bakwhl surveyors .
translation: While these chiefs were in prison, the surveyors returned.

transcription: Way ii sim dit'e'lt iit depdiithl hlguts'uusxhl lax̲ ha'niiyip gi'namihl Indian Agent tun ehl hli gyedihl Gitwinhlguu'l .
translation: They hurriedly measured out the tiny reserve that the Indian Agent gave Kitwancool.

transcription: "One mile by one mile," diphiida 'nuu'm .
translation: "It's one mile by one mile," we said.

transcription: G̲asg̲oohl lax̲bits'iixwhl surveyors , ii k̲'ap 'nihl g̲anwihl hehl Gitwinhlguu'l gyuu'n , needii sgidimdii k'uhl t'aadihl surveyor's reserve .
translation: Because the surveyors were so afraid, the villagers say today that they should not have made a surveyor's reserve.
